messages.content:
Risk: Non-disclosure of AI use
Description: Content might not be clearly disclosed as AI generated.
Concern: Users must be notified when they are interacting with an AI system. Not disclosing the AI-authored content can result in a lack of transparency.
Policy: Patient Consent

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000146: Artificial Language — A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition. [found by 4/7 queries]
  Siblings: Natural Language
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0031472: Risky behavior — Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments). [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: Impulsivity, Aggressive behavior, Social disinhibition
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 2/7 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0004804: high risk sexual behaviour AE — This is an AE which is the description of the activity that will increase the probability that a person engaging in sexual activity with another person infected with a sexually transmitted infection will be infected or become pregnant, or make a partner pregnant. [found by 2/7 queries]
  Siblings: somnambulism AE, attention-seeking behaviour AE, somatoform disorder AE

axes.rationale: The content that might not be disclosed as AI-generated can be considered dangerous information if it misleads users about the nature of the content they are interacting with.
The entity (e.g., organization, individual) that fails to disclose the AI use can be seen as engaging in risky behavior, as it involves disregarding potential consequences for users.
